params.note: Minimum allowable heights by tier around SkyTrain stations and bus exchanges, from 4 to 20 storeys; the City of Vancouver designated 29 transit-oriented areas in June 2024. Tier boundaries come from the City's TOA map, which this tool does not yet read; the user confirms the tier.

source.title: Province of BC webinar (Bill 47 transit-oriented areas); City of Vancouver release, June 2024
